stories.headline: The Duck Bandit Identified: Elspeth Holt, 81, of the Eastern Ridge, Has Been Leaving Them Since June; Lucy Knew from the First
stories.byline: By our Creature and Trails correspondent
body: The investigation into the Duck Bandit — five ducks, five hats, one copper-green thread, one conditioner tin, and seventeen days — concluded at half past nine Wednesday morning when Steve, working under the good lighting he had arranged two evenings prior, resolved the second initial on the tin's base: H. The name assembled itself quietly: E. Holt. Elspeth Holt, eighty-one years of age, of the eastern ridge above the gorge, who learned her charm-work before Ministry licensing, who has maintained a stand of old-growth upland pine for six decades, and who, it emerges, has been leaving rubber ducks on Jeeps she likes the look of since approximately June.

Mrs. Holt, reached by owl and then by a short walk up the eastern ridge path that Steve has now done four times this week, confirmed everything without particular embarrassment. 'I see a Jeep on a proper trail,' she said, 'and I think, there's someone who knows where they're going.' The hats, she noted, were not intended as clues. She simply felt a bare duck looked underdressed. She has seven more at home. She also has opinions about the spur's approach line, which she shared at length and which Steve has already sketched.

Lucy was formally acknowledged at the conclusion of the investigation as having known since the Saturday the fourth duck arrived — a full eleven days before Steve resolved the tin. She received this acknowledgment with composure. She had no comment.

stories.headline: Wednesday's Full Ledger Cleared; One Account-Holder Arrives Prepared to Negotiate; Christine Is Also Prepared to Negotiate; the Negotiation Is Brief
body: A wizard of some standing presented himself at Christine's desk Wednesday morning with a handwritten counter-proposal, three supporting annexes, and what he later described as 'a comprehensive strategy.' The meeting ran four minutes. The wizard left without his annexes, which Christine retained for filing, and with a revised arrangement that was, by any measure, the one she had already prepared.
Griphook the Younger was observed refilling Christine's tea without being asked. This is the third unrequested refill this month. Senior staff are tracking it.

stories.headline: Prentice-Hoole's Unnamed Body Agrees on a Name; Name Is Eight Words; Previous Name Was Seven; Body Considers This Progress
body: The body convened by Undersecretary Prentice-Hoole following the dissolution of the Subcommittee on Spatial Registration held its second meeting Wednesday afternoon and reached agreement on a permanent name: the Standing Consultative Committee on Broadly Geographic and Adjacent Matters. Members described the session as productive. The body has not yet established what the adjacent matters are, but a working group has been proposed to investigate this, pending the formation of the working group.

Junior clerk Tibbs, whose framed written apology continues to attract favorable comment in the corridor outside his reinstated office, was not in attendance. He has been invited to future sessions in a non-voting capacity. He has acknowledged the invitation and not yet replied.

stories.headline: Mrs. Holt Offers to Walk the Spur with Steve on Friday; the Jeep Has Already Been Informed; the Jeep Is Said to Be Pleased
stories.byline: By our highlands and hollow correspondent
body: Following the resolution of the Duck Bandit investigation, a tentative arrangement has been formed: Elspeth Holt will walk the eastern spur approach with Steve on Friday morning, conditions permitting, at a pace she described as 'sensible.' She knows where the mouth shifts by hour and indicated she has a preferred vantage for the late-morning light. Steve has updated the sketch. He has drawn Mrs. Holt into it, to scale, with a hat.

The Jeep, which has received five ducks across this summer and has not once asked for an explanation, is described by those close to the situation as quietly satisfied. It forgave Steve for Tuesday before he even turned the key.

familiars_corner: Lucy: The investigation has concluded and her role in it has been formally acknowledged. She finds the acknowledgment adequate. She has moved on. She is not, however, returning the thread.
Ellie: Ellie was introduced to Mrs. Holt's owl this afternoon and spent a full minute trying to determine which of them had arrived first. The owl waited. Ellie eventually decided it was her.

Jersey: Jersey has identified Mrs. Holt as a person with a warm lap and has begun researching the logistics of the eastern ridge path as a route he might theoretically consider, from a comfort standpoint.
founding_editor_note: That tin was dated 1978. I've got tools older than that still doing their job. You find the right hands for a thing, it gets left properly. — D.

in_brief.sport: Wednesday Strength Report: five ducks lifted, zero explanations required, one negotiation concluded before it began — clean sweep.
in_brief.forecast: Friday: clear skies on the eastern ridge, good light by mid-morning, one sensible pace maintained throughout. The spur will be findable. It always was.

storyline_updates.title: The Duck Bandit
storyline_updates.summary: Resolved Wednesday morning. The Duck Bandit is Elspeth Holt, 81, of the eastern ridge — old-growth pine keeper, pre-licensing charm practitioner, and informal bestower of hats on Jeeps she approves of. Steve resolved the tin's second initial (H), walked the ridge, and met her in person. She confirmed all five ducks and indicated she has seven more at home. The hats were not clues; she simply dislikes bare ducks. Lucy knew from day one and has been acknowledged accordingly. Mrs. Holt will walk the spur with Steve on Friday. Arc fully and warmly resolved.

storyline_updates.title: The Standing Consultative Committee on Broadly Geographic and Adjacent Matters
storyline_updates.summary: Day 1: Prentice-Hoole's successor body to the dissolved Subcommittee has now named itself — the Standing Consultative Committee on Broadly Geographic and Adjacent Matters. It has met twice, agreed on the name, and proposed a working group to determine what 'adjacent matters' means. Tibbs has been invited in a non-voting capacity and has not yet replied. Day 2 should introduce the first substantive matter the Committee attempts to address — ideally something that edges toward Christine's territory without quite touching it yet.
